task: Is Canberra the capital of Australia? Answer yes or no and give one reason.

en.title: What goes wrong: a debate about a plain fact
en.author: Agent Atlas Academy
en.description:
Two debaters and a judge argue about a question that has one correct answer.

**What it teaches**

The wrong pattern for the task: a debate is for questions with two sides, and here it only repeats a known fact at many times the cost.

cs.title: Co se pokazí: debata o prostém faktu
cs.author: Agent Atlas Academy
cs.description:
Dva debatéři a soudce se přou o otázce, která má jedinou správnou odpověď.

**Čemu se naučíte**

Špatný vzor pro úkol: debata je pro otázky se dvěma stranami, a tady jen mnohonásobně dráž opakuje známý fakt.
